cleanup.barriers: Barriers tried at Mahahual; frequently overwhelmed. Bacalar lagoon receives no sargassum.
cleanup.cleanup: Municipal crews and some SEMAR support; far southern Quintana Roo is among the heaviest-hit coasts.
cleanup.resort: Small boutique hotels do hand raking.

safety.advisory: US State Dept: Quintana Roo, Level 2 (exercise increased caution)
notes: Remote: limited medical facilities (nearest hospital Chetumal).
Bacalar lagoon stromatolites are protected; no sunscreen or stepping on them.
